note: Supreme law of Georgia: 'საქართველოს კონსტიტუცია'.
'ზაკონოდატელობა' is a Russianism; correct Georgian is 'კანონმდებლობა'.
Legal enactment passed by Parliament and signed by President.
Draft text submitted for legislative consideration. Written as one word.
Legal act containing binding rules of general conduct.
Act addressed to a specifically determined person or entity.
Systematic codification of laws (e.g. სამოქალაქო კოდექსი, სისხლის სამართლის კოდექსი).
Branch of law dealing with crimes and punishments.
Branch of law dealing with private rights, contracts, and property.
Branch governing the activities of administrative agencies of government.
Branch regulating employment relationships and labor rights.
Body of rules recognized as binding on sovereign nations.
'სუდი' is a Russianism; standard Georgian is 'სასამართლო'.
High judicial organ of constitutional control located in Batumi.
Highest and final court of cassation jurisdiction located in Tbilisi.
Second-instance appellate judicial body (Tbilisi, Kutaisi).
First-instance court in municipal districts; 'საქალაქო სასამართლო' in cities.
'სუდია' is a Russianism; correct term is 'მოსამართლე'.
Layperson sworn to give a verdict in a legal trial.
State official conducting criminal prosecution.
Central state prosecution authority.
Licensed defense counsel and legal practitioner.
Entity recognized by law as having separate legal personality.
Individual human being with legal capacity.
'ისკი' is a Russianism; correct Georgian is 'სარჩელი'.

latin: filing a lawsuit / initiating legal action
note: Commencing civil or administrative litigation before a court.
'ისტეცი' is a Russianism; correct Georgian is 'მოსარჩელე'.
'ატვეტჩიკი' is a Russianism; correct Georgian is 'მოპასუხე'.
Person not a direct party to an action but having a legal interest in the outcome.
Person authorized by law or contract to act on behalf of another.
'დოვერენოსტი' is a Russianism; correct Georgian is 'მინდობილობა'.
'დოგავორი' is a Russianism; correct Georgian is 'ხელშეკრულება'.
Mutual assent between two or more parties.
'უსლოვიე' is a Russianism; correct Georgian is 'პირობა'.
Failure to perform contractual obligation without valid justification.
'უშერბი' is a Russianism; correct Georgian is 'ზიანი'.
Remedy restoring claimant to the economic position had damage not occurred.
Compensation for physical pain, mental suffering, or injury to reputation.
'ნეუსტოიკა' is a Russianism; correct Georgian is 'პირგასამტეხლო'.
'პრიგავორი' is a Russianism. In criminal law, use 'განაჩენი', not 'გადაწყვეტილება'.
'რეშენიე' is a Russianism. In civil/administrative cases, court renders 'გადაწყვეტილება'.
'ოპრედელენიე' is a Russianism; correct Georgian is 'განჩინება'.
Pre-trial procedural constraint applied to criminal accused (bail, detention).
Deprivation of liberty as criminal sanction or preventive measure.
Custodial restraint during investigation and trial.
'ზალოგი' is a Russianism; in criminal procedure, bail is strictly 'გირაო'.
'დავნოსტი' is a Russianism; correct Georgian is 'ხანდაზმულობა'.
Maximum statutory period after an event within which legal action may be taken.
'ობვინენიე' is a Russianism; correct Georgian is 'ბრალდება'.
'ობვინიაემი' is a Russianism; correct Georgian is 'ბრალდებული'.
'ასუჟდენი' is a Russianism; correct Georgian is 'მსჯავრდებული'.
Person declared not guilty by criminal court judgment.
'პატერპევში' is a Russianism; correct Georgian is 'დაზარალებული'.
'სვიდეტელი' is a Russianism; correct Georgian is 'მოწმე'.
'პაკაზანიე' is a Russianism; in judicial procedure, witness testimony is 'ჩვენება'.
Scientific or technical investigation ordered by court or investigator.
'ვეშდოკი' is a Russianism; correct Georgian is 'ნივთმტკიცება'.
'დოკაზატელობა' is a Russianism; correct Georgian is 'მტკიცებულება'.
Duty placed upon a civil party to establish factual allegations.
Fundamental constitutional principle that one is innocent until proven guilty.
State when a court judgment can no longer be appealed by standard channels.
'ობჟალოვანება' is a Russianism; correct Georgian is 'გასაჩივრება'.
Petition appealing first-instance court judgment to appellate court.
Petition appealing appellate judgment to the Supreme Court on points of law.
'ისპალნიტელნი ლისტი' is a Russianism; correct Georgian is 'სააღსრულებო ფურცელი'.
State enforcement agency executing final court judgments.
Exclusive legal right given to the creator of literary or artistic work.
Category of property including intangible creations of human intellect.
Government authority or licence conferring a sole right to make or use an invention.
Legally registered symbol, word, or logo identifying goods of a manufacturer.
Official code defining criminal offenses and penalties in Georgia (abbreviated სსკ; note ambiguity with Civil Code). Source: matsne.gov.ge/ka/document/view/16426.
Fundamental legal code regulating private property and personal non-property relationships (abbreviated სსკ). Source: matsne.gov.ge/ka/document/view/31702.

latin: Code of Administrative Offences of Georgia
note: Code regulating administrative violations and misdemeanor penalties (abbreviated ასკ). Source: matsne.gov.ge/ka/document/view/28216.
Code governing public administration, administrative proceedings and freedom of information (abbreviated სზაკ). Source: matsne.gov.ge/ka/document/view/16270.
Code regulating judicial procedure in civil litigations (abbreviated სსპკ). Source: matsne.gov.ge/ka/document/view/29962.
Code governing criminal investigation, prosecution and trial procedures (abbreviated სსსკ). Source: matsne.gov.ge/ka/document/view/90034.
Organic law governing employment relationships, contracts and workers rights. Source: matsne.gov.ge/ka/document/view/1155567.
Code establishing tax liability, rates and tax administration in Georgia. Source: matsne.gov.ge/ka/document/view/1043717.
Code regulating import, export and customs control in Georgia. Source: matsne.gov.ge/ka/document/view/4597648.

latin: Law of Georgia on Personal Data Protection
note: Law regulating processing and storage of private individual data. Source: matsne.gov.ge/ka/document/view/5835942.
Person suspected of crime before formal indictment/charges are filed. Distinct from ბრალდებული (the accused).
Criminal verdict establishing the guilt of the defendant and imposing sentencing.
Criminal verdict finding the defendant not guilty.
Court order resolving procedural motions without deciding the main case on merits.
Final judgment on merits in civil and administrative cases.
Judgment delivered strictly in a criminal trial.
Normative act issued by the Government of Georgia or investigative ruling by prosecutor/investigator.
Written application to a court or public authority; distinct from formal lawsuit (სარჩელი).
Formal complaint challenging an act, decision or omission of an authority or lower court.

latin: statement of defense / response to claim
note: Written counter-statement and defense submitted by defendant in civil procedure.
Independent claim brought by a defendant against the plaintiff in the same proceedings.
Duty of debtor to perform an action or abstain from it. Distinct from responsibility/liability (პასუხისმგებლობა).
Legal consequence of breaching obligations or committing unlawful acts.
Statutory monetary penalty imposed by public authority or criminal court.
Executive order, decree or regulation issued on the basis of and for execution of a law.
Total aggregate of material things and intangible claims. Distinct from right of ownership (საკუთრება).
Legal right of exclusive possession, enjoyment and disposition over property.
Person having actual physical control or possession over a thing. Distinct from owner (მესაკუთრე).
Legal titleholder of property with right of ownership.
Measure of state coercion imposed strictly for a criminal offense.
Statutory measure specifying adverse consequences of violating a legal rule.
Time interval established by law or contract. Distinct from limitation period (ხანდაზმულობა).
Normative act that has ceased to have legal effect from a certain date forward.
Legal act or contract devoid of legal validity from inception.
Specific status in domestic violence, human trafficking and human rights contexts.
Unlawful act prohibited by the Criminal Code. Distinct from administrative offense (სამართალდარღვევა).
Unlawful act incurring administrative, civil or disciplinary liability.
Breach of internal organizational or civil service duty.
Pledge of immovable property to secure monetary performance.
Security interest over movable property or intangible claims.
Detention ordered for the purpose of extraditing an individual to another sovereign state.
Mental state of intent (განზრახვა) or negligence (გაუფრთხილებლობა) in committing violation.
Subjective state where actor foresees and desires or consciously permits consequences.
Failure to exercise reasonable care foreseen or expected by law.
Unforeseeable and unavoidable external circumstance exempting from liability. Written as one word.
Georgian statutory synonym for force majeure in Civil Code §398.
State law enforcement body within the Ministry of Internal Affairs (შსს).

latin: Ministry of Internal Affairs of Georgia
note: Executive ministry responsible for public order, borders and police (შსს).
State agency recording immovable property titles, corporate records, and liens.
Self-governing association of licensed notaries in Georgia.

latin: High Council of Justice of Georgia
note: Constitutional body ensuring independence and appointment of common court judges.
Executive ministry leading legal affairs, penitentiary system and public services.
Independent constitutional official overseeing observance of human rights.
Independent state authority investigating crimes committed by public officials.
State intelligence and counter-terrorism agency (სუს).
Payment made to make amends for injury, loss or expropriated property.
Legal remedy obligating tortfeasor or breaching party to restore losses.
Profit the aggrieved party would have gained if obligation had been duly performed.
Direct real decrease or loss of an asset caused by breach.
Assets of debtor available for distribution to creditors in bankruptcy.
Inability of debtor to meet matured pecuniary obligations.
Court-ordered liquidation proceeding under Rehabilitation and Collective Satisfaction Law.
Party legally bound to discharge a performance or debt to creditor.
Party entitled to demand performance of obligation from debtor.
Liability where each co-debtor is responsible for full discharge of debt.
Liability arising only upon default or failure of the principal debtor.
Contractual transfer of rights/claims from original creditor to third party.
Agreement by which a new debtor takes over an existing debt with creditor consent.
Forcible taking of property by state for public need during emergency with compensation.
Uncompensated judicial forfeiture of crime instrumentalities or illegal assets to state.
Constitutional taking of private property for pressing public need upon prior fair compensation.
Limited real right burdening a piece of real estate for benefit of another parcel.
Real right to use and gather fruits of another person property without altering its substance.
Heritable and alienable right to have a construction on or beneath anothers land.

latin: bona fide purchaser / purchaser in good faith
note: Buyer who acquires property for value without knowledge of defect in sellers title.

latin: transfer of title / transfer of ownership
note: Formal conveyance of ownership by agreement and delivery or public registry entry.
Contract between employee and employer establishing employment terms and wages.
Initial employment period (up to 6 months) for evaluation of employee suitability.
Agreement concluded between employer and employee union regarding working conditions.
Work performed beyond standard 40-hour work week, compensated at increased rate.
Lawful termination of employment contract initiated by employer on statutory grounds.
Constitutional temporary collective stoppage of work by employees in labor dispute.
Temporary suspension of work or closing of enterprise initiated by employer.
Equal protection principle enshrined in Constitution and Labor Code.
State oversight LEPL supervising compliance with labor and safety standards.

preferred: საქართველოს კონკურენციისა და მომხმარებლის დაცვის სააგენტო
note: State regulatory LEPL enforcing antitrust and consumer protection laws.

latin: Law on the Protection of Consumer Rights
note: Statute regulating consumer rights, warranties and unfair commercial practices.
Agreement by parties to submit disputes to binding private arbitration.
Final decision rendered by arbitration tribunal enforceable through court.
Alternative dispute resolution process guided by a neutral mediator.
Voluntary agreement of parties terminating litigation or dispute.
Settlement of legal controversies through judicial, arbitral or negotiated processes.
Legal authority of a particular court to hear and determine a specific case.
Official notification summoning a party or witness to appear before a court.
Judgment entered against a party who failed to appear or defend after due notice.

preferred: ლევან სამხარაულის სახელობის სასამართლო ექსპერტიზის ეროვნული ბიურო
latin: National Forensics Bureau named after Levan Samkharauli
note: Official state forensic laboratory agency of Georgia.
Binding interpretation of a legal act issued by authorized organ.
Capacity of a legal act to produce binding enforceable effects.

latin: period of validity / term of operation
note: Temporal duration during which a contract, license or act remains in effect.
Extinguishment of contractual or legal relationships.
Unilateral repudiation of a continuing contract on statutory or agreed grounds.
Declaration that an act or transaction has no legal force.
Constitutional right to introduce a draft law in the Parliament of Georgia.
Parliamentary confirmation consenting to be bound by an international treaty.
Official notification of withdrawal from an international treaty.
Official state gazette and digital repository of all normative acts of Georgia.

latin: registry excerpt / excerpt from public registry
note: Official certified extract evidencing title, corporate standing or encumbrances.
Constitutive document governing corporate structure and governance of legal entity.
Person or entity that creates a legal entity or foundation.
Owner of equity share in limited liability company (შპს) under Law on Entrepreneurs.
Owner of registered shares in a joint stock company (სს).
Statutory representative holding managerial authority in legal entity.
Corporate oversight body supervising the management board in joint stock companies.

latin: general meeting of partners / partners meeting
note: Supreme governing organ of limited liability company.
Supreme decision-making body of joint stock company.
Officer appointed by court to manage debtor estate in bankruptcy proceedings.
Court-approved restructuring scheme enabling insolvent business to recover.
Official court-verified schedule of valid creditor claims in insolvency.
Creditor holding collateral, pledge or mortgage security priority.
General creditor lacking collateral or security priority.
Unique state identifier assigned to real estate parcel in public registry.
Land parcel and subsoil with attached buildings and permanently fixed objects.
Any material thing that is not real estate or attached to land.
Claims and rights which can be transferred or alienated under Civil Code §152.
Devolution of property of deceased person to heirs by will or law.
Deceased person whose estate is subject to succession.
Person entitled to inherit property by statutory law or testament.
Formal unilateral legal declaration disposing of estate after death.
Succession determined by statutory kinship degrees in absence of will.
Succession governed by testator valid last will and testament.
Minimum statutory portion of inheritance guaranteed to children, spouse and parents.
Formal act by heir declaring acceptance of estate before notary within 6 months.
Official notarial deed certifying rights of heir to estate.
Itemized financial projection of construction, service or transaction expenses.
Deed signed by parties confirming delivery and acceptance of goods or completed works.
Agreed timeframe during which seller or contractor warrants absence of defects.
Material or legal flaw diminishing value or usability of purchased good.
Third-party rights encumbering property not disclosed to buyer.
Physical divergence of delivered thing from contract specifications.
Specific qualifying contractual condition or legal exception.
Specific exemption from general legal rule.
General binding legal standard established by competent authority.

latin: material change of circumstances / clausula rebus sic stantibus
note: Ground for contract adaptation or termination under Civil Code §398.
Contract where each party undertakes reciprocal obligations.
Transaction requiring declaration of will by only one party (e.g. will, power of attorney).
Declaration of will aimed at creating, altering or terminating civil rights and duties.

latin: declaration of intention / manifestation of will
note: External expression of party intent producing legal effect.

latin: transaction entered under fraud or deceit
note: Voidable transaction where consent was induced by intentional misrepresentation.

latin: transaction entered under duress or coercion
note: Voidable transaction where consent was procured through unlawful threat or force.
Voidable transaction entered under fundamental misconception of essential terms.
Null and void transaction concluded only for appearance without intent to produce effect.
Null transaction concluded to cover up another intended transaction.

latin: public order / public policy / ordre public
note: Fundamental legal order; transactions violating it are void under Civil Code §54.
Transaction void for violating accepted standards of public decency and morality.

latin: legal capacity / capacity to hold rights
note: Capacity to have civil rights and duties, arising at birth and ending at death.
Capacity of person by their own actions to acquire and exercise civil rights.
Person declared legally unable to understand or manage their actions independently.
Individual with psychosocial disability receiving court-appointed legal support.
Person legally appointed to protect and represent minor under 7 or support recipient.
Person appointed to assist minor aged 10-18 in exercising legal transactions.
Bailiff or officer executing court judgments under enforcement law.
Licensed private professional authorized to enforce civil judgment debts.
Judicial document mandating compulsory enforcement of court judgment.
Statutory process of compulsory execution of judgments and claims.
Legal seizure or prohibition on alienation of debtor assets or bank accounts.
Compulsory deduction order issued on bank account to recover tax or debt.
Public forced sale of seized property to satisfy creditor judgments.
Foreclosure auction conducted by National Bureau of Enforcement or pledgee.
Constitutive entry in public registry establishing real property ownership.
Written contract for alienation of real estate requiring public registry authentication.
Gratuitous transfer of property into ownership of another party with their consent.
Contract where lessor transfers temporary possession of property for rent.
Lease of income-yielding property or land with right to gather fruits.

Contract granting commercial license to use trademark, brand and business model.
Financial agreement where business sells accounts receivable to a factor.

latin: contract for work and services / independent contractor contract
note: Contract where contractor undertakes to perform work and client to pay agreed fee.
Contract for provision of specified services against remuneration.
Contract transferring money or fungibles with duty to return same quantity.
Loan agreement where bank disburses funds at interest and repayment terms.

Irrevocable independent commitment of bank to pay beneficiary upon demand.
Banking payment arrangement guaranteeing seller payment upon compliant presentation.
Exclusive legal rights of authors over their literary, scientific and artistic works.
Rights protecting performers, phonogram producers and broadcasting organizations.

latin: Sakpatenti (National Intellectual Property Center of Georgia)
note: National office administering patents, trademarks and intellectual property rights.
Contract binding parties to keep proprietary and trade secrets confidential.
Confidential technical or financial information having commercial value.
Non-public material price-sensitive information concerning listed securities.
Statutory framework preventing legalization of illicit income and terror financing.
Financial intelligence unit receiving reports on suspicious transactions.
Tax and customs administration authority under the Ministry of Finance.
Official examination of taxpayer books and returns by Revenue Service.

latin: tax demand notice / notice of tax assessment
note: Administrative act assessing taxes, penalties and interest payable by taxpayer.
State statutory security interest on taxpayer property securing tax debt.
Administrative or judicial challenge of Revenue Service tax assessments.

latin: Dispute Resolution Council at the Ministry of Finance
note: Appellate administrative body reviewing appeals against Revenue Service decisions.
